name: NC Comicon
blurb: A locally owned, creator-focused comics and pop-culture convention at the Durham Convention Center in the Triangle.

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'North Carolina Comicon | Bull City November 14th & 15th, 2026' and 'We'll see you Nov 14th & 15th at the Durham Convention Center!'

notes: Organizer legal name not found (site only says 'Locally owned and operated'); left blank. The guests page is a single undifferentiated '2026 Guests' grid with name-only cards (no bio/role text per card), so 'Known for' is left blank except where independently well documented; all were defaulted to cat 'comics' since the page gives no sub-category labels and this is an exclusively comics-focused con — 'Uzuri' in particular could not be confirmed as a specific role (possibly cosplay) and is categorized comics by the same default. Excluded 'Oni Press' and 'Saturday AM' from the guest grid as they are publishers/companies, not people.
